layout.arrangement: Section-divider slide: thin red-bordered light-gray content panel inset within a white outer frame; single large bold red title centered horizontally and slightly above vertical center; small yellow numbered badge in top-right corner of the panel; no other content

regions.name: Outer frame
regions.content: plain white margin surrounding the inner slide panel

regions.name: Content panel
regions.position: approximately 6% to 94% horizontally, 8% to 100% vertically (panel touches bottom edge)
regions.content: light gray rectangle with thin dark-red border; contains the title and the slide-number badge

regions.name: Title
regions.content: the text 'Linear Regression' in large bold red sans-serif

regions.name: Slide-number badge
regions.position: top-right of panel, approx 88-93% horizontally, 10-17% vertically
regions.content: yellow oval with purple outline containing the numeral 2

regions.name: Cursor artifact
regions.content: small pen/arrow pointer icon (screen-recording cursor, not slide content)

layout.hierarchy: The red title dominates absolutely; everything else is empty space. Secondary element is the small yellow badge; the red panel border is the only other visual structure.

visual_elements.description: Full-slide inner panel: light gray rectangle with a thin (1-2px) dark red border, inset from the white outer background on top, left, and right; it extends to the bottom edge of the visible frame
Slide-number badge: small horizontal oval/ellipse, yellow fill, medium purple-blue outline, containing the black numeral '2' centered inside
visual_elements.position: top-right corner of the gray panel

visual_elements.description: Small pen-style mouse/pointer cursor icon (recording artifact, angled pen nib pointing down-left)
visual_elements.position: lower-right quadrant, below and right of the title

imagery: No photographs, illustrations, or icons besides the small pen-cursor artifact in the lower-right area (a screen-recording pointer, not slide content)
typography_notes: Single text element: 'Linear Regression' set in a bold sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like), large display size (roughly 40-44pt equivalent), dark red, title case, centered. No italics, no all-caps, no bullet lists anywhere on the slide. Badge numeral is small plain sans-serif black.
animation_state: No build state visible; this is a static section-title slide with all elements (title + page number) already revealed. No partial bullets or mid-animation cues.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF). 2. Insert a rectangle spanning from ~0.5in from top/left/right edges down to the bottom edge of the slide; fill it light gray (#E9E9E7) and give it a thin (1pt) dark red (#C00000) outline. 3. Add a text box centered horizontally, vertically at ~48% of slide height, containing exactly 'Linear Regression' in Arial Bold, ~40pt, color #C00000, centered alignment. 4. In the top-right corner of the gray panel (about 0.3in from its top and right edges), draw a small oval (~0.45in wide, 0.35in tall) with yellow fill (#FFFF99) and a 1.5pt purple-blue outline (#7070D0); type the numeral '2' inside in black ~12pt, centered. 5. Do not add bullets, images, or footers. 6. Optionally note (but do not draw) the small pen cursor in the lower-right is a video-recording artifact and should be omitted from the recreation.
